_comment: Community-submitted base designs. Each entry is one player's build. Add a design by pasting the share code from the planner. Votes are NOT stored here - they live in the vote service (see worker/), and the site fetches them at page load.
voteApiNote: Base URL of the deployed community worker, e.g. https://wardogs-votes.<you>.workers.dev. While this is empty the site shows the static empty state and no submit form, rather than controls that cannot do anything.

designTags._comment: The only list of design tags there is. The site reads it from here for the filter bar and the pickers, build.ps1 inlines it into the planner, and test/tags.js holds both to it. The worker stores whatever ids it is sent and validates their shape only, so a new tag added here needs no worker deploy: the price is that it never sees this file, and the price of that is the map- prefix below.
designTags._mapPrefix: Every tag in the map group starts with map-, because that prefix is the whole rule the worker can enforce without a copy of this list: a submission must carry at least one map- tag. Ids other than map-any are map- plus the map id in data/artillery-maps.json, and test/tags.js fails if a map there has no tag here.

groups.label: Where it works
groups.hint: At least one. Pick the map it is laid out for, or Any map if the ground does not matter.

groups.label: What it is for
groups.hint: Optional, as many as fit. This is what somebody scrolling the list is actually choosing between.

tags.label: Anti-infantry
tags.hint: Built to stop people on foot: cover, wire, firing positions.

tags.label: Anti-vehicle
tags.hint: Stingray, hedgehogs, anything that turns armour away.

tags.label: Anti-air
tags.hint: Vanguard CIWS or Talon 9K-SAM covering the sky above it.

tags.label: Artillery
tags.hint: Built around a mortar and its shelter.

tags.label: Zone control
tags.hint: Meant to be planted on the objective and held.

tags.label: Recon
tags.hint: Towers, radio, eyes on ground you do not hold.

tags.label: Starter
tags.hint: Cheap and quick, for the first build of a match.

designTags._exclusive: A tag marked exclusive answers the same question as the rest of its group and cannot be true beside them: picking Any map clears the named maps, and picking a named map clears Any map. Both pickers do this, so nothing has to check it afterwards.
designTags._noComments: Nothing under groups is a comment key. That whole array is re-serialised into the planner by build.ps1, so anything added there ships to every player.
